name: Kozakai Aya
source:
[b]A Gap-Year Waitress at a Doll Café![/b]

A waitress at the same café that Hatsuyuki works at.
Graduated from Shirasaki Academy the year prior. Despite being a talented individual, as her work as student council president would show, she managed to fail her entrance exams, forcing her to take a gap year.
Though she acts calm and relaxed no matter who she's dealing with, sometimes she doesn't come across as entirely genuine, and it can be hard to grasp how she truly feels.
She's closer to Hatsuyuki than any of his classmates are. Perhaps something happened between them in the past?
